tldr: Midday batch (Sep 3): Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei publicly asked governments for narrow authority to block unsafe AI deployments and proposed AI-specific taxes, committing $200M to AI-society research — while the Trump administration formally reversed course, with Commerce Secretary Lutnick declaring 'We trust Anthropic' after months of export restrictions. Anthropic also launched Enterprise Frontier Safeguards (zero data retention + misuse detection with data in customer-held clouds). Elsewhere: Hugging Face shipped 207 Apache-2.0 WebGPU kernels for in-browser AI, Hermes Agent added first-class multi-source secrets management, and llama.cpp's expert-cache PR lifted Qwen3.8-Flash-Next decode to 25-29 t/s on dual-3090 DDR4 rigs.
